text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Lady Turbo, you were insanely fast in 
today's mock race too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Lady Turbo, your running is truly like a 
gale. It shall leave everything and 
everyone far behind.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!? What is it!? What on earth 
happened to you guys!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... A while back, while watching a 
hero interview, you said, "I want to be 
praised like this," didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is why, today, we would like to... 
praise Lord Turbo's running to our hearts' 
content.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~!! Yeah, actually, this does feel 
kinda nice!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Lady Turbo's breakaway front-running is 
truly magnificent... Watching it always 
lifts my spirits.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The whirlwind that Turbo-sama stirs 
up will surely bring a refreshing summer 
storm to the racing world...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu... Totally!! 'Cause Turbo's fast!! 
Next time, I'll race with Zephyr and 
Miracle too!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, hehe. Your kindness feels just like 
a refreshing breeze...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Seeing them this happy makes it 
all worthwhile, doesn't it, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly... It makes me want to keep 
right on going tomorrow as well.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh!! Turbo is number one!! Turbo is 
the fastest of all!!
